_reads: signed per-replication stage records only. No estimation, no pooling, no masked quantity, no row re-read

apparatus_faults.defect: the v6 CLI did not forward --repo-root to run_registration, whose default is '.', so assert_documents_adopted resolved the two governed documents against the process's working directory (dci1/) and reported both missing; stage 1 then wrote that readiness verdict as a 28.3 terminal report because REGISTRATION_INCOMPLETE was a terminal status
apparatus_faults.reason: a defect in the caller, not a verdict about this model: both governed documents exist and declare ADOPTED at the commit the record itself names, no registration manifest existed, and no behavioural row had been generated anywhere in the study

firewall: §6.1: four replications analysed separately and never pooled; no cross-model scalar carries a claim, and §15 registers no cross-model multiplicity family

study_level.l5_withheld: generalisation is never licensed by this design
study_level.statement: No replication reached GATE_5_FREEZE identified. The study makes no claim about the effect at any level. Every replication's terminal status is a statement about the apparatus reaching identification, not about the effect.
